screening_rules: publication record is in the unchanged frozen 2026-04-01..2026-06-30 census
record is a PRL Letter and is not titled Comment, Reply, Erratum, Retraction, Withdrawal, or Correction
title indicates a quantitative mechanism, law, scaling, dynamics, transition, transport, fluctuation, or response
candidate is not one of the 17 papers in acquired_source_pool
arXiv identity satisfies the existing exact rule: unique DOI, else normalized exact title plus first-author family
the pinned arXiv source endpoint contains at least one decodable TeX file

tex_display_environment_count.note: A deterministic syntax count used only as a formula-density screening signal, not as case eligibility.
